name: Daybreak Sear
description: Set the great prod on its foot plate in the earth and pack the soil about it so it cannot rock.

name: Buoying Stirrup
description: Fix the gaze on the mark and lock the head so the great prod keeps the same line.

name: Searvigil
description: Lay the long heavy bolt in the great groove with both hands and seat it against the string.

name: Stock Respite
description: Pair a body breath with a qi breath through the draw so the great prod is spanned without strain.

name: Iron Setback
description: Loose the great prod so a bolt as long as an arm drives through shield and body armour.

name: Twangblink
description: Move the great prod two paces at a time with a partner and reset the foot plate.

name: Remnant Trigger
description: Read the field from the high mound of the firing court and mark where the foe will gather.

name: Searscourge
description: Loose a great bolt with a hawk's stillness so it pierces plate and the guard behind it.

name: Decimating Cranking
description: Hold the great prod fully spanned while qi gathers and then loose a bolt that carries the whole store.

name: Spanhavoc
description: Loose a great bolt carrying the shooter's full stored qi so it breaks a heavy shield and the guard beyond.

name: Might Tripbar
description: Mark two firing places side by side with a heel scrape so the pair stand in step.

name: Daybreak Cranequin
description: Draw two bolts from the quiver together and set them one over the other on the rail.

name: Buoying Latch
description: Look to the shooter on the left and read the set of the bow before loosing.

name: Verity Boltrail
description: Look to the shooter on the right and match the aim so both bolts meet the same mark.

name: Might Windlass
description: Count a shared beat aloud with the partner so both bows are loosed at the same instant.

name: Hellish Releaseclack
description: Loose two bolts one after the other at the same mark so the second follows the first closely.

name: Unseen Quarrel
description: Step the pair forward in time so neither moves ahead of the other.

name: Healing Cranequin
description: Span in turn so one bow is always loaded while its partner reloads.

name: Hoarfrost Twang
description: Loose from two angles with qi in each bolt so the paths cross on the mark.

name: Nova Bowprod
description: Send one bolt to break the guard and a second into the opening it leaves.

name: Brutalizing Windlass
description: Loose both paired bolts as one blow with the whole weight of the two shooters behind them.

name: Daybreak Tripbar
description: Dig a heel hold into the basin slope and lean uphill to keep the body from sliding.

name: Veritystock
description: Sight down the steep slope and judge how much the drop lengthens the flight.

name: Waning Latch
description: Read the haze that hangs in the basin to judge how far the far slope really lies.

name: Ruinous Releaseclack
description: Loose from the upper slope so the quarrel gathers speed as it falls onto the mark.

name: Mightspan
description: Go down the slope in short sliding steps with the bow held clear and the body upright.

name: Buoying Trigger
description: Listen for the echo of a stone thrown into the basin to judge the distance across.

name: Bowprod Wrath
description: Loose a charged bolt downhill so the speed of its fall adds to the force of the qi.

name: Dismantling Stirrup
description: Gather qi for a breath and loose a fan of bolts that fall over a wide patch of the basin floor.

name: Glint Stock
description: Loose a bolt from the high rim with full qi so it falls with the force to split heavy cover.

name: Sear Respite
description: Set the feet on the firm gravel of the bend where the bank turns against the stream.

name: Stockinsight
description: Find the mark on the far bank and judge the width of the water between.

name: Galvanizing Cranequin
description: Draw to a long even count so the full stored force is held for the far shot.

name: Buoying Boltrail
description: Lay a long light bolt on the rail and check that it lies straight along the groove.

name: Latch Insight
description: Wipe the spray of the river from the rail and string with a dry cloth.

name: Blazespan
description: Loose a long flat shot across the river with qi trimming the line of flight.

name: Blinding Twang
description: Skim along the inside of the bend in quick light steps to keep the same range.

name: Chime Stirrup
description: Read the mist off the water to learn where the far bank lies and what moves on it.

name: Stock Vitality
description: Span the bow again at a steady pace between shots without losing sight of the far bank.

name: Tempered Setback
description: Loose a charged bolt across the river so it strikes with full force on the far shore.

name: Chime Trigger
description: Gather qi and loose a bolt around the line of the bend onto a mark that stands past it.

name: Hellish Cranking
description: Loose a quarrel carrying the full reach of the shooter's qi across the whole width of the river.

name: Latchvigil
description: Carry two prods slung one on each shoulder so either can be brought up at once.

name: Bowprod Premonition
description: Mark two foes at once and hold both in the gaze like a hawk watching a pair of prey.

name: Energizing Windlass
description: Tune both prods until they pull the same so neither bow favours the other.

name: Stockvigil
description: Fletch the bolts with hawk feathers cut to one pattern so both prods loose the same flight.

name: Galvanizing Boltrail
description: Rest both prods on a fork so neither tires the arms while the shooter waits.

name: Blaze Releaseclack
description: Loose from one prod and take up the other so a bolt is always in the air.

name: Torrent Quarrel
description: Move between two firing marks in a set pattern with both prods held ready.

name: Might Boltrail
description: Span one prod while the other rests on the shoulder so reloading never halts the fire.

name: Elevating Sear
description: Hold two marks in the sight and decide which prod answers which.

name: Tempered Twang
description: Loose both prods at one mark from crossed lines so both bolts enter the same breach.

name: Twangmettle
description: Pin the foe's cloak with one bolt and the weapon arm with the other so the foe is held.

name: Rending Quarrel
description: Draw the force of both prods into one qi stream and loose a single bolt of doubled weight.

name: Iron Twang
description: Loose a bolt from each prod in one beat with full qi so the pair of strikes breaks a strong guard.

name: Discerning Tripbar
description: Count the plates and rivets on a foe's armour to learn how it is laid.

name: Energizing Trigger
description: Shift the weight from the rear foot to the front as the body track and qi track meet.

name: Bowprod Vitality
description: Find the gap at the elbow or knee of an armoured foe and set the aim on it.

name: Cranequin Premonition
description: Ready the body breath and the qi breath together so the loose comes from both.

name: Hollowspan
description: Loose along both tracks so a narrow bolt finds the edge of a plate and bites.

name: Silt Latch
description: Step round an armoured foe and switch the aim from one gap to the next.

name: Searruin
description: Loose a probing bolt at one joint and watch how the foe guards to find the open one.

name: Facetsear
description: Drive a charged bolt into the elbow or knee gap so the joint of the armour is forced.

name: Nova Setback
description: Hold the aim on one plate edge while qi gathers and loose a bolt that splits it.

name: Facet Cranking
description: Loose a great charged bolt along both tracks to break a breastplate and the body beneath it.

name: Searinsight
description: Take a seat at the watch post and rest the bow on the sill in the dark.

name: Clairvoyant Stirrup
description: Close one eye for a time and let the other grow used to the dark of the basin.

name: Chimestock
description: Run the fingertips along the rail in the dark to check the bolt lies straight.

name: Galvanizing Sear
description: Hood the watch lantern so its light falls on the rail and nowhere else.

name: Galvanizing Stock
description: Bind a strip of felt on the string so its twang does not carry through the night.

name: Blaze Cranking
description: Loose at a shape in the dark with qi sharpening the sight of the shooter.

name: Lightning Releaseclack
description: Move along the basin floor on soft steps with qi damping the sound of the feet.

name: Latchrespite
description: Tell friend from foe by the outline and gait of a shape moving in the dark.

name: Windlass Reckoning
description: Loose a charged bolt in full dark so it strikes before the foe has heard the string.

name: Latchwrath
description: Put out a foe's torch with a blunt bolt so the watch can close in the dark.

name: Lancing Setback
description: Loose a great quarrel through the black of the night so it strikes a guarded foe unseen.

name: Elevating Latch
description: Coil a long cord on the spool at the stock so it pays out without a snarl.

name: Vital Tripbar
description: Tie the cord to the bolt with a river knot that tightens under load.

name: Veritylatch
description: Feel the cord for water and swelling that would weaken it before the shot.

name: Vital Cranequin
description: Set the reel spindle in its mount so it turns freely and holds when braked.

name: Energizing Bowprod
description: Lay the trailing line along the stock in loose loops that cannot catch the bolt.

name: Ponderous Stirrup
description: Loose a bolt that trails a cord so the line settles across the body of the foe.

name: Searvalor
description: Wind the reel with qi in the arms to draw a snared foe off balance.

name: Blinding Span
description: Step clear of a snapped cord and let go of the reel before the line whips back.

name: Unerring Stock
description: Test the line with a light tug to learn whether the bolt has caught or only crossed.

name: Fastening Quarrel
description: Loose a cord bolt that wraps both arms of the foe and binds them to the body.

name: Gyvesear
description: Gather qi and loose a bolt that opens a net of cords over a small group.

name: Immobilizing Setback
description: Loose a great bolt whose qi tightened cords hold a strong foe and drag it to the ground.

name: Verity Tripbar
description: Take a bearing on a far mark against two landmarks and hold it in the mind.

name: Elevating Boltrail
description: Stand with the feet wide on the plateau and speak the oath of the shot under the breath.

name: Windlass Respite
description: Judge how far the wind will push the bolt over a long flight across open land.

name: Blaze Trigger
description: Loose along the held bearing in a long flat line to a distant mark.

name: Granite Twang
description: Step across the plateau while keeping the bearing and the oath unbroken.

name: Trigger Vigil
description: Check the taken bearing a second time against the far landmark before the loose.

name: Cranking Havoc
description: Loose a charged bolt along the long bearing so it strikes hard at the end of its flight.

name: Twangscourge
description: Hold the oath through a long still breath and loose when the bearing is perfect.

name: Nova Quarrel
description: Loose a quarrel sworn to a far mark with full qi so it holds its line and breaks the guard.

name: Sear Premonition
description: Wait with the bow lowered until the gale drops and then raise it in the lull.

name: Buoying Sear
description: Breathe in time with the gusts and speak the oath on the slack of the wind.

name: Equipoise Cranequin
description: Trim the fletching of the gale bolts short and stiff so they do not tumble in the wind.

name: Clairvoyant Stock
description: Anchor the bow with a short rope to a stake so a gust cannot tear it from the hands.

name: Unerring Stirrup
description: Drop into a low wide stance with the bow close to the chest in a hard gale.

name: Lacerating Bowprod
description: Loose a stiff short bolt that rides the gale and holds a straight line.

name: Silt Span
description: Step in the lee of each gust so the wind never takes the shooter full on.

name: Windlass Premonition
description: Read the rhythm of the gusts over the grass and find the beat of the wind.

name: Novastock
description: Loose a charged bolt into the gale so wind and qi together drive it through a guard.

name: Gnashing Cranking
description: Hold the oath and the bow through a gust and loose in the instant the wind turns.

name: Merciless Setback
description: Loose a great quarrel sworn to its mark so it drives straight through a gale and a guard.

name: Waning Tripbar
description: Take a bearing from the crest to a mark in the valley below.

name: Torrential Span
description: Kneel just below the crest line so the shooter does not show against the sky.

name: Vigilant Boltrail
description: Breathe slowly through the sworn bearing until the hands are still and the mark is clear.

name: Revitalizing Cranequin
description: Rest the bow on a rock at the crest for a firm base against the gusts.

name: Glint Quarrel
description: Loose along the sworn bearing from the crest at a mark across the valley.

name: Span Rocketry
description: Run along the crest below the skyline to a new firing place.

name: Remnant Stirrup
description: Judge the distance across a valley by the size of a known rock on the far ridge.

name: Facettwang
description: Loose a charged bolt from the crest so it strikes true at the far end of the sworn bearing.

name: Tempered Span
description: Hold the aim on the mark for a long still breath while qi builds and then release one great bolt.

name: Ruinous Latch
description: Loose a great bolt sworn to a far mark so it crosses the valley and breaks a strong guard.

name: Energizing Stock
description: Brace the great prod on the ground with stakes against the push of the open wind.

name: Illuminating Sear
description: Draw the great prod by windlass on a sworn count with the feet planted wide.

name: Radiant Windlass
description: Trim the fletching of the great bolt to a low stiff shape that the wind cannot lift.

name: Healing Latch
description: Sling the great prod on a broad strap across the back for the walk between marks.

name: Radiant Bowprod
description: Warm the string between the palms on a cold morning so it does not snap when drawn.

name: Twang Ruin
description: Loose the great prod across open ground with the aim set against the push of the wind.

name: Silt Trigger
description: Move the great prod between firing marks in short stages and re-stake it each time.

name: Daybreak Boltrail
description: Reload the great prod on a sworn count while a partner watches the field.

name: Waning Trigger
description: Read the sky for the change of wind before the shot is committed.

name: Latchruin
description: Loose a great bolt with stored qi so it holds its line in the wind and pierces a guard.

name: Span Devastation
description: Hold the great prod spanned through a long gust while qi gathers and then loose the whole store.

name: Titanic Releaseclack
description: Loose a bolt whose head bursts into shards on impact and throws splinters across the target.

name: Searing Releaseclack
description: Loose a great quarrel with the whole qi of the shooter so it breaks cover and a strong guard.

name: Equipoise Stirrup
description: Plant the feet a pace back from the cliff edge and speak the oath of the shot.

name: Waning Boltrail
description: Sight down the steep fall of the ground and judge how it shortens the shot.

name: Illuminating Tripbar
description: Tie a rope round the waist and anchor it to a stake before leaning over the drop.

name: Farseeing Latch
description: Mark the line of fall of a dropped stone to learn where a bolt would land.

name: Intent Cranequin
description: Slow the breath at the edge until the hands are quiet over the drop.

name: Novalatch
description: Loose steeply downward so the quarrel falls onto the mark below the edge.

name: Spanblink
description: Walk the edge on narrow sure steps with qi in the soles for grip.

name: Vigilant Bowprod
description: Judge the height of the drop and how much it adds to the speed of the bolt.

name: Galvanizing Windlass
description: Crouch back from the edge to span the bow out of sight of the mark.

name: Tempered Releaseclack
description: Loose a charged bolt down from the edge so the long fall adds weight to the blow.

name: Ferocious Cranking
description: Gather qi and loose a fan of bolts from the edge to fall across the ground below.

name: Pitiless Releaseclack
description: Loose a great quarrel from the edge sworn to fall true so it breaks the strongest cover below.

name: Healing Tripbar
description: Lean the body against a gale from the side to keep the stance square to the mark.

name: Unerring Sear
description: Take a bearing on the mark and note how far the gale pushes it off the line.

name: Waning Windlass
description: Tie a strip of cloth to a stake to show the strength and the angle of the gale.

name: Revitalizing Stock
description: Crouch behind a low rock with the bow turned a little into the gale.

name: Span Scourge
description: Loose with the aim set upwind of the mark so the gale carries the bolt onto it.

name: Granite Cranking
description: Slide sideways with the gale to keep the bow steady between shots.

name: Resurgent Stirrup
description: Judge how many body widths of offset the gale needs on the aim.

name: Brutalizing Bowprod
description: Loose a charged bolt across a gale with the offset held so it still strikes a guard hard.

name: Ruinous Stock
description: Gather qi and hold the offset steady through a gust and loose when the gale peaks.

name: Facet Quarrel
description: Loose a great bolt through a crossing gale with full qi so it still bursts a strong guard.

name: Boltrail Vitality
description: Mark the spot where a signal bolt must land so those at the far camp can see it.

name: Vigilant Tripbar
description: Pitch the voice to a high clear call that carries over the open plateau.

name: Beneficent Trigger
description: Cut a notch in the fletching so the bolt whistles in flight and can be heard far off.

name: Blaze Sear
description: Loose a whistling bolt high so its sound and path tell the far camp where the shooter stands.

name: Torrential Twang
description: Move between relay points along the ridge to pass the call on at each one.

name: Energizing Cranequin
description: Read the count and the pitch of a whistling bolt to learn what the sender means.

name: Titanic Quarrel
description: Loose a whistling charged bolt so it announces the shot and then pierces the mark.

name: Charter Setback
description: Call a barrage by voice and loose a whistling fan of bolts that pins foes under the sound.

name: Resounding Stirrup
description: Loose a great signal bolt that carries the shooter's voice and message far and strikes where it lands.

name: Revitalizing Tripbar
description: Set the feet in the short grass of open country with the body low and the bow tight.

name: Radiant Latch
description: Read the tracks and the bent grass to learn where the quarry went and how fast.

name: Dazzling Cranking
description: Place each foot slowly on bare ground and go forward on the side of the foot.

name: Beneficent Windlass
description: Wet a finger and hold it up to see that the wind does not carry scent to the quarry.

name: Buoying Stock
description: Breathe the oath to take the quarry cleanly and hold still on the last breath.

name: Span Reckoning
description: Loose a single bolt at a vital spot on the quarry from a patient stalk.

name: Might Setback
description: Freeze mid stride when the quarry looks up and move on when it looks away.

name: Discerning Bowprod
description: Read the ears and the tail of the quarry to tell when it will bolt.

name: Ironstock
description: Loose a charged bolt that passes through a thick hide and reaches the heart.

name: Eviscerating Twang
description: Gather qi in a long hush and loose one bolt at a distant quarry in the open.

name: Setback Reckoning
description: Loose a great quarrel sworn to take the quarry at one shot and stop even a charging beast.
